name: ROS2 Diff-Drive Robot
author: Henosync Team — Monash University
description: Generic ROS2 differential-drive ground robot via rosbridge. Drive via /cmd_vel (arrow-key teleop); no map position yet.

host.label: Rosbridge IP Address
host.description: IP of the machine running rosbridge_server on the robot

cmd_vel_topic.label: Cmd Vel Topic
cmd_vel_topic.description: geometry_msgs/Twist topic the robot subscribes to for movement

odom_topic.label: Odometry Topic
odom_topic.description: nav_msgs/Odometry topic for speed telemetry. Leave blank to disable.

max_linear_speed.label: Max Linear Speed (m/s)
max_linear_speed.description: Arrow Up/Down at full press drives at this speed

max_angular_speed.label: Max Angular Speed (rad/s)
max_angular_speed.description: Arrow Left/Right at full press turns at this rate
